temples.name: Sri Punyalingeswara swamy kshetram
temples.location: #3-330/1H/2, Opp. Balaji Ramakrishna Temple, Valigonda Road, Choutuppal, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri, Telangana - 508252
temples.description: Sri Punyalingeswara Swamy Kshetram is a sacred Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, located in Choutuppal, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District, Telangana. The temple is devoted to Sri Punyalingeswara Swamy and features the sacred presence of the Dwadasha Jyotirlingas (12 Jyotirlingas). The temple offers devotees a peaceful spiritual environment for darshan, prayer, pooja, and devotional activities.
